summary: CSG Systems International filed an 8-K reporting that it and NEC Corporation received CFIUS clearance for their merger, marking the final regulatory approval needed. On October 29, 2025, CSG entered into a merger agreement where a wholly owned NEC subsidiary will merge into CSG, with CSG surviving as a wholly owned NEC subsidiary. The filing does not disclose price per share or premium. The board's recommendation is not restated. All regulatory approvals are now secured. The deal is expected to close pending other customary conditions. Watch for the exact closing date and any shareholder vote or last-minute litigation.
